# Diviso

> Diviso is a smart bill-splitting and shared-expense app for friends, family, roommates, and travel groups. Bilingual (Arabic + English), free Splitwise alternative with AI-assisted tracking, multi-currency support, and PWA offline mode.

Diviso helps groups log expenses, see who owes whom, and settle up without awkwardness — over the web, as a PWA, or via WhatsApp share links. Built by Takamul Al-Bina Est. in Saudi Arabia.
